mandatoryForm.why: Article 986 makes Article 998 the form to be used for this category, and the committed record says twice that the Article 989 form is not used here.
mandatoryForm.composedFrom: the Article 998 statutory text held byte-exact in custody and bound to this packet by content digest

MOTION FOR EXPUNGEMENT FOR MISDEMEANOR CONVICTION FOR A FIRST
II. MISDEMEANOR CONVICTION FOR A FIRST OFFENSE POSSESSION OF
mandatoryForm.whyReproducedRatherThanParaphrased: the committed component note states that Article 986(A) makes the statutory forms exclusive, so the rendering must reproduce the Legislature's own words rather than paraphrase them, and that under Article 986(C) the court name is the only authorized variation.
fieldsDeliberatelyNotAddedToThisForm: how many charges or counts the arrest carries
original arrest charge and statute for every count
whether the conviction is a misdemeanour or a felony
the statute the mover was convicted under
whether this was a first offense for possession of marijuana
mandatoryForm.whyNotAdded: the Article 998 statutory form prints no field for any of them and Article 986(C) allows only the name of the court to vary. They are required participant inputs on the committed memo and are carried on the Article 992 order, which identifies the record the decree reaches, and in the guide.
mandatoryForm.thePartIeNameLine: The statute rules the NAME line '(Last, First, MI)'. This packet leaves that line for the participant and states the order in the guide, because the platform fact this field takes is one full-name string with no surname marked and a split of it would be a guess about the mover's own surname on a motion the Bureau matches against a rap sheet.
mandatoryForm.theTwoDateLines: The statute prints '(MM/DD/YYYY)' beside the date of birth and the conviction date. Both are rendered in that format and the instruction is printed beside each, as the source prints it.

componentsNotGenerated.conditionTheRecordStates: Generated only where the participant may qualify for the Article 983(F) exemption, whose grounds are non-conviction grounds and so rarely reach this track.
componentsNotGenerated.whyNotGenerated: the condition is that the participant may qualify for the Article 983(F) exemption, whose grounds the record itself describes as non-conviction grounds that rarely reach this track. Article 977(D) is a CONVICTION track, so nothing on either fixture establishes the condition and the component is not generated. The record's own words about the exemption, the fifteen-day return and the non-refundable fee are carried in the participant and filing instructions, and item 4 of the record's required-before-filing list, which claims the packet gives the participant this form, is printed unchanged and corrected beneath.
